user.title: Connect Hermes Assist
user.description: Connect Home Assistant Assist to Hermes Agent using the documented Hermes HTTP API. The integration builds /v1/chat/completions and /v1/runs automatically.

init.title: Hermes Assist options
init.description: Tune Hermes Assist behavior. Connection URL and token remain in the original setup entry; the API model ID, timeout, voice wait timeout, AI handoff generation, background completion delivery, and system prompt can be adjusted here.
